Hanoi, Vietnam1974 contributions

Lovely little hideaway, great service and cocktails.
Nov 2023 • Couples
We were out for a few cocktails before dinner and had seen Nectar come up on a few searches of "best cocktails in Hanoi". We weren't disappointed.

As others have said it's a bit of a challenge to get to - down a side alley and up several flights of stairs (be warned for your return trip after a few drinks...).

There are some pretty elaborate but tasty cocktails. The personal favorite was Boulevard of Broken Dreams but their Penicillin is worth it too. Prices are quite reasonable. Staff are attentive and know their stuff.

Definitely worth a visit and a nice little spot for a few pre or post dinner drinks.
